spec.title: Mixed Company
spec.brief: Defend the base through 4 waves with 4 towers. Base HP 3.
playerKnows: Enemies walk the path (~) from the spawn (S) to your base (B). Each enemy that reaches the base costs 1 base HP.
Towers go on buildable slots (_) next to the path. You have a limited number of towers per level.
Waves start only when the fly calls start_wave. Read the enemy rules carefully: they react to what happened in the previous wave.
agentKnows: You are a drosophila carrying a cassette. You see only a small window around you; unknown tiles show as '?'.
Coordinates are [x,y]; x grows east, y grows south. north = y-1, south = y+1.
Each action costs one tick. When the tick budget ends the level is lost.
Place all towers before starting waves; a wave runs fully in one action.
A tower hits the enemy closest to the base within its range once per sub-tick. Slots near path bends cover more tiles.
Slots are listed in td.buildableSlots; the enemy rules are in td.opponentCharter.

opponent.charter: Wave 1: 5 grunts. Wave 2: 6 runners (2 hp, speed 2). Wave 3: 8 grunts. Wave 4: 3 brutes (6 hp). If any enemy reached your base, the next wave has +2 enemies.

reasons: All 4 waves cleared with base HP 3/3.
